plan.title: Cedar Chapel Choir Evening

drafts.invitation:
Cedar Chapel Choir Evening
Saturday 13 February 2027
Grace Chapel

Dear members and friends,

You are cordially invited to the Cedar Chapel Choir Evening organized by River Parish. The evening will begin with registration at 17:45, followed by the programme commencing at 18:00.

The programme will consist of a welcome, a performance by the Cedar Chapel Choir led by Musa Bello, and a closing address. Please note that ministerial permission for outdoor seating is still pending and the price of the flower arrangement has yet to be confirmed.

We look forward to sharing this special musical celebration with you.

Yours faithfully,

Ruth Alabi
Secretary
